Name: Skin Changer
Author: soufiw666
Description:
Description

Skin Changer is a Stardew Valley mod for SMAPI that adds a convenient in-game appearance picker. Open it with a hotkey, pick a ready-made look from a grid of live icons, or build your own by adjusting individual parts. Every change only lasts for the current session and is never written to your save file — so you can experiment freely without worrying about messing up your save.

Installation instructions

1. Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or later.
2. Download the latest release of the mod.
3. Unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder, so you end up with the path Mods/SkinChanger/manifest.json.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI (not directly).

Main features

- Four tabs of ready-made looks: Feminine, Masculine, Other (mixed base sprites), and Villagers.
- 24 villager impressions (Abigail, Sebastian, Haley, Harvey, Linus, Shane, and more) rebuilt out of ordinary farmer parts — they still animate normally, wear your clothes, and work with any recolor pack.
- Live icon grid — every icon is an actual render of your farmer wearing that look, not a static image.
- Fine-tune by part: hair, skin tone, shirt, trousers, and accessory, plus a separate swatch row for hair, trouser, and eye color.
- Nothing touches your save: the mod temporarily restores your real appearance right before the game serializes, then re-applies your chosen look afterward. The Reset button or quitting without saving fully undoes any changes.
- HUD button — a small live portrait under the clock opens the picker with one click; it can be moved or turned off in the config.
- Full compatibility with content packs: hairstyles, shirts, trousers, skin tones, and accessories are read from loaded content at runtime, so any pack that adds or reskins parts is picked up automatically.
- Two console commands: skin_open (manually open the picker) and skin_selftest (render diagnostics — handy when reporting a bug).

Usage

- Open / close the picker — F9
- Open the picker — click the portrait button under the clock
- Apply a look — click any icon
- Undo everything — Reset button in the picker

Two console commands are available in the SMAPI window:

- skin_open — open the picker, useful if the hotkey clashes with another mod.
- skin_selftest — render one icon per tab and report whether the render path works. Handy when reporting a bug: paste what it prints.

Requirements

- Stardew Valley 1.6 or later.
- SMAPI 4.0.0 or later.
- Supports single player and multiplayer, on Windows / macOS / Linux.
- No additional mods required — works as a standalone SMAPI mod.
- Multiplayer note: as a farmhand, your appearance is continuously streamed to the host, so the host's save may end up storing whatever look you're wearing. Press Reset before disconnecting to be safe — the mod also warns about this in the log when you join someone else's world.

Shout outs

- The SMAPI team and Pathoschild for the modding framework and Pathoschild.Stardew.ModBuildConfig, without which building and running this mod wouldn't be possible.
- ConcernedApe for creating Stardew Valley.
- The community of recolor and content pack authors, whose open formats made automatic compatibility possible.
- Everyone who tested early versions and sent in reports via skin_selftest — you helped catch a lot of bugs.
